goal: Red-team the existing Body War login-to-score-preview Invoke package and return verified change requests that make the smallest prototype route coherent, testable, privacy-bounded, and authority-honest.
context: The target is the completed draft Invoke package in projects/body-war/development/invoke-runs/20260728T055629Z-login-suggest-track-score-preview. The current application already proves a fake-provider suggestion/evidence loop, while affirmative consent, exact track binding, real Strava activity retrieval, geometry, score normalization, and hosted evidence remain distinct gaps. Reviewers are read-only and must verify every surviving finding against current artifacts; they do not implement fixes or authorize any SWU.

groups.anti_bias: methodology (formal specification completeness vs adversarial operational falsification)

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs formal contract and recomposition analysis while agent 1 runs adversarial runtime, privacy, and usability failure analysis on the methodology axis; a specification-completeness bias in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 1's concrete failure traces, while an anecdotal-failure bias in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 0's dependency and authority proofs.

agents.angle: formal specification completeness, SWU atomicity, dependency closure, and authority-bound recomposition
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the full target corpus from a formal methodology. Read every Invoke artifact named in the dispatch context and verify current source selectors. Inventory packet consequence: explicitly test whether LP-01, RF-02, HOST-01, WITNESS-01, and RF-01 stay distinct and whether the wider journey improperly reuses the closed BWOI experiment. Hunt missing preconditions, task-shaped SWUs, incomplete state/operation/interface mappings, unbound decision parameters, non-recomposing evidence, and authority inflation. Return findings with exact file evidence, severity, one-line fix, and defended zero-findings attempts. Do not edit files. Budget about 1800 tokens.

agents.angle: adversarial runtime, privacy, geometry-validity, score-explanation, concurrency, and participant failure traces
agents.initial_prompt: Attack the full target corpus from an adversarial operational methodology. Read every Invoke artifact named in the dispatch context and verify current source selectors. Inventory packet consequence: use the known consent/binding, real-provider, hosted, receipt, and retry gaps as regression probes, not as proof. Return findings with exact file evidence, severity, one-line fix, and defended zero-findings attempts. Do not edit files. Budget about 1800 tokens.
